notes.title: Oculus Support!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Oculus Support[/b][/h2]
I finally got myself a Quest 2, I can now test my games on the Oculus. There's still perhaps some polishing I want to do for both the Oculus and Vive but things are progressing nicely. 

[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause a drone to spawn before round start in the shooter mini game
[*]Fixed teleportation on Oculus and (probably) on the Valve Index... Still don't have an Index ːsteamsadː
[*]Fixed a bug that would slow down the walk speed if the player looked straight up or down
[/list]

Thank you everyone for sticking around! It's been a lot of fun so far working on this project. Hopefully I can finish this off before the end of the year. 

-Leland <3

notes.title: Another Big Update
notes.notes:
[h2][b]New Engine Version!! [/b][/h2]
I updated from Unreal 4.19 to 4.26. This came with a lot of things to fix but will allow me to use more engine features and plugins. This also seems to have effected physics a bit so the carnival games will play a little differently. 

[h2][b]Changes/Additions[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed wall and ceiling colors in apartment. 
[*]Updated the lighting again for all the maps.
[*]Added a more proper controls board in the starting room. 
[*]Added collisions around maps so players can't walk outside the play area.
[*]Added a bounding box around play area. If a player is outside of it for 5 seconds they'll be teleported back to the play space. 
[*]Changed the spectator screen away from a full screen capture. This will increase performance. 
[*]Set the controller model to a more generic one rather than being a Vive controller. 
[*]Holding the grip buttons will reset player position to starting location. 
[*]Changed the drone glow color to yellow in the shooter mini game. 
[*]Added a new text effect when a drone is destroyed. 
[*]Changed the amount of bottles knocked to reset from 12 to 8. With the physics change and the removal of a ball it made it pretty difficult to get to 12. 
[*]Some new easter eggs ;) 
[/list]

[h2][b]Steam Leaderboards [/b][/h2]
Added leaderboard support. You'll find the leaderboards in game in the shooter game and in the carnival at ring toss and the bottle knock games. If I get more time I may add in filters for friends only, and possibly pages. 

[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed nav mesh in all maps with teleportation. 
[*]Fixed swapping items between hands. 
[*]Fixed collision issues with various apartment meshes. 
[*]Fixed healthbar on guns in shooter game.
[*]Removed some unnecessary dynamic effects from both the tutorial and main base vending machine level that improved performance A LOT. 
[*]Fixed sound concurrency for certain physics objects. 
[/list]

[h2][b]Added Inputs[/b][/h2]
I added inputs for the Valve Index and Oculus. I won't go as far as to say they're actually supported since I can't test them myself but the inputs are hooked up... They should wooooork? For the most part. Give it a shot if you have one of those but like I said, not actually supported. With that you can switch the controls board in the starting room to view your devices controls.

Coffee VendoR is getting there, just a couple more updates until I'm satisfied. It's been a long journey, thanks for everyones support during it!

-Leland <3

notes.title: Movement And Optimizations
notes.notes:
[h2][b]New Movement System[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Players can now choose between teleport and smooth locomotion in the "main menu" map. 
[*]Using smooth locomotion you walk with the left pad.
[*]There's now also a rotate button. Using the right pad players can rotate. 
[*]In the "main menu" map players can choose rotation amounts between, 15, 30, 45, and 90 degrees. Or they can turn off snap turn for smooth turning.
[/list]

[h2][b]New Shooter Gun Model[/b][/h2]


[h2][b]Better Lighting Builds[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Apartments has gotten increased lighting fidelity.
[*]Carnival has also received this lighting improvement and has also been changed to night.
[*]The vending machine has also gotten lighting improvements. 
[/list]

[h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Made a lot of optimizations, in general the game should run a bit better. 
[*]Fixed some player collisions in Apartments. 
[*]Made the vending machine a tad bit smaller. I didn't realize how big I made the area until I played in a smaller playspace. I may even work on making the components of the vending machine moveable.  
[*]Added some new little easter egg props. 
[*]Made the mini games more consistently track high scores. 
[*]The bottle knock mini game now has one less ball. 
[*]Added a framerate limit. Before the GPU would be working very hard to get even more frames despite having more than enough. This will reduce your GPU usage without impacting gameplay. 
[*]Removed the settings board. I'll have to rework it a lot before I re add it. 
[/list]

I can't stress enough at how poorly my code has aged ːsteamsadː I've spent A LOT of time just cleaning up old code and scratching my head at my past self. 

Once everything is properly optimized and I get that last minigame in there I will likely stop development for Coffee VendoR. I've been spreading myself a little too thin lately. If you include my "real job" at the studio I've been trying to work on 4 projects at once and it's just not sustainable. 

Thanks for everyones support. 

-Leland <3

notes.title: Now with (some) music!
notes.notes:
Hello all! This has been a very fun launch and I've enjoyed reading what everyone has to say about the game. 

One of the more recent pieces of feedback I got was from [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCSVjrpufOzTd3jZsUGs-L0g/featured]Ben Plays VR[/url], a Youtuber. He suggested the game could use some music so I got working on that earlier today and just finished. 

You can now make your coffees with some nice tunes! You can switch between a few songs. Music by Eric Matyas at [url=https://soundimage.org/]Sound Image[/url]

Thanks again everyone! With the minor bug fixes and gameplay tweaks out of the way I can finally start working on the next mini game!
